column1: # WHY: a per-file ceiling keeps any single suite file from silently growing to dominate
# the run. Seeded from a measured serial run, rounded up to the next multiple of 5 plus a
# A tests/test_*.sh file with NO row here fails the registry<->files correspondence guard
# (internal/repoguard TestRuntimeBudgetsCorrespondence, both directions). Adding a test
# file is a conscious placement decision — read tests/README.md before adding one; the
# usual right answer is to EXTEND an existing shard.
# ENFORCEMENT lives in the Go suite runner (internal/suiterunner): it measures each file
# against its ceiling and emits the budget-clause lines (BUDGET WATCH / PARALLEL-SENSITIVE
# are screening findings; SERIAL CONFIRMED OVER BUDGET is an authoritative breach). This
# table is the registry those checks read; the correspondence guard keeps it honest.
# After change 0370 the suite is Go-native: every row below is a `# docket-suite: go`
# wrapper (or a POSIX product suite) discovered by the runner. The frozen Bash runner and
# its per-assertion profilers are gone, so no row describes them.
